info.name: Get unused credits for a traveler

items.docs:
Returns a list of unused credits associated with a traveler 
along with details such as the PNR ID, trip ID, airline details, credit expiry date, and the source of booking (e.g., NDC). 
Travelers can redeem unused credit for future bookings with the same airline where the credit was earned.

info.name: Get unused credits for a company

items.docs: Returns the list of company unused credits which can be used by any employees of the company.

info.name: Get transferable unused credits for a company

items.docs:
Returns the list of transferable company unused credits which can be used by any employees of the company.
The unused credits can be transferred to another traveler.

info.name: Migrate Unused Credits of a traveler to and fro Company Credits

items.docs: This API will be migrate unused credits from individual credits to company credits and vice versa.
